subject: Banking and Insurance
notes: Banking and insurance core. Numerical answers are stated in correctAnswer with working in explanation.

questions.text: An institution that accepts deposits and lends money is a
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: A bank accepts deposits and grants loans and advances.

questions.text: The bank that acts as banker to the government and other banks is the
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: The central bank acts as banker to the government and commercial banks.

questions.text: The central bank of India is the Reserve Bank of
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India is the countrys central bank.

questions.text: Commercial banks create credit by lending more than their cash reserves
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Banks create credit through the deposit and lending multiplier.

questions.text: List the functions of commercial banks
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Accepting deposits granting loans and advances and agency and utility services.
questions.explanation: These are the primary and secondary functions of banks.

questions.text: Explain the functions of the Reserve Bank of India
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: The RBI issues currency acts as banker to government and banks controls credit manages foreign exchange and supervises the banking system.
questions.explanation: Cover note issue banker functions credit control and supervision.

questions.text: A deposit that cannot be withdrawn before a fixed maturity is a
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Fixed deposits are repayable only after a fixed term.

questions.text: The account that allows deposits and withdrawals at any time for business is a
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: A current account permits frequent transactions for business.

questions.text: A savings account usually pays interest while a current account usually does not
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Savings accounts earn interest while current accounts typically do not.

questions.text: List the types of bank deposits
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Savings current fixed and recurring deposits.
questions.explanation: These deposit types suit different customer needs.

questions.text: Explain the principles of sound lending
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Sound lending follows the principles of safety liquidity profitability purpose and security ensuring loans are recoverable and productive.
questions.explanation: Cover the five principles guiding bank lending.

questions.text: The written promise to pay a fixed sum on demand is a
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: A promissory note is an unconditional promise to pay a fixed sum.

questions.text: Banking conducted through the internet and mobile devices is
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Digital banking provides banking services electronically.

questions.text: A cheque is a bill of exchange drawn on a banker payable on demand
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: A cheque is a special bill of exchange drawn on a bank.

questions.text: List the types of negotiable instruments
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Promissory notes bills of exchange and cheques.
questions.explanation: These are the main negotiable instruments.

questions.text: Explain the benefits of digital banking
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Digital banking offers convenience round the clock access lower cost faster transactions and wider reach though it raises security concerns.
questions.explanation: Balance the convenience and cost benefits against security risks.

questions.text: The mechanism by which losses are shared among many who face similar risk is
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Insurance pools risks so losses are shared among many policyholders.

questions.text: The principle that the insured must have a financial interest in the subject is
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Insurable interest is the legal financial stake in the insured subject.

questions.text: The principle of utmost good faith requires full disclosure of material facts
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Utmost good faith requires both parties to disclose all material facts.

questions.text: List the principles of insurance
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Utmost good faith insurable interest indemnity subrogation contribution and proximate cause.
questions.explanation: These principles govern the insurance contract.

questions.text: Explain the different types of insurance
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Insurance includes life fire marine health and general insurance each covering different risks of life property and liability.
questions.explanation: Describe each type and the risk it covers.

questions.text: The regulator of the insurance sector in India is
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India regulates insurance.

questions.text: The formal demand by the insured for payment of loss is an insurance
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: A claim is the request for compensation of a covered loss.

questions.text: The process of identifying and controlling risks is risk management
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Risk management identifies assesses and controls risks.

questions.text: List the methods of handling risk
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Avoidance reduction retention and transfer of risk.
questions.explanation: These are the four basic ways of dealing with risk.

questions.text: Explain the functions of IRDAI
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: IRDAI regulates the insurance industry protects policyholders issues licences and sets rules for products pricing and solvency of insurers.
questions.explanation: Cover regulation and policyholder protection functions.

questions.text: Assertion: Life insurance is a contract of indemnity. Reason: The insured is compensated exactly for the loss suffered
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
options: Both assertion and reason are false
Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion
Assertion is true but reason is false
Assertion is false but reason is true
questions.explanation: Life insurance is not indemnity because a life cannot be valued; the sum assured is paid regardless of loss.

questions.text: Match the principle to its meaning
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
options: Subrogation - insurer takes over rights after paying
questions.explanation: Subrogation transfers the insureds recovery rights to the insurer after a claim.

questions.text: The account opened by two or more persons jointly is a
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: A joint account is operated by two or more account holders.

questions.text: Explain the types of banks in India
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Indian banking includes the central bank commercial banks cooperative banks and development banks each serving different sectors and purposes.
questions.explanation: Describe each type and its role in the banking system.

questions.text: A loan secured by pledging goods or property is a secured loan
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: A secured loan is backed by collateral pledged to the bank.

questions.text: Read the case: A shop is damaged by fire and the owner claims more than the loss expecting to profit. Which insurance principle prevents this
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: The principle of indemnity prevents profit because the insured is compensated only for the actual loss not more.
questions.explanation: Apply indemnity to cap the claim at the actual loss.

questions.text: Read the case: A customer wants convenient banking without visiting a branch and is concerned about security. Recommend a banking option and a safeguard
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: The customer should use digital banking and protect it with strong passwords two factor authentication and vigilance against phishing.
questions.explanation: Recommend digital banking with security safeguards.

questions.text: The proportion of deposits banks must keep with the RBI is the
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: The CRR is the share of deposits banks must keep with the RBI.

questions.text: Explain the credit creation process of commercial banks
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Banks create credit by lending a multiple of their reserves because each loan redeposited allows further lending limited by the reserve ratio.
questions.explanation: Explain the deposit multiplier and its limit.

questions.text: The policy premium is the amount paid by the insured for coverage
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: The premium is the consideration paid for the insurance cover.

questions.text: Explain the importance of insurance to business
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Insurance protects business from losses of assets and income provides certainty encourages investment and supports credit by covering risks.
questions.explanation: Cover risk transfer certainty and credit support.

questions.text: List the instruments of credit control used by the RBI
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Bank rate repo rate cash reserve ratio statutory liquidity ratio and open market operations.
questions.explanation: These tools regulate the cost and quantity of credit.

questions.text: Explain the difference between life insurance and general insurance
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Life insurance covers human life and pays on death or maturity while general insurance covers property liability and other non life risks usually annually.
questions.explanation: Contrast the subject matter and duration of the two.

questions.text: The bank that lends mainly for agricultural and rural development is NABARD
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: NABARD is the apex institution for agricultural and rural credit.

questions.text: A bank pays simple interest of 5 percent on a fixed deposit of 20000 for one year. The interest earned is
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Interest equals principal times rate so 20000 times 0.05 equals 1000.

questions.text: Explain the factors to consider before granting a loan
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: A bank considers the borrowers character capacity capital conditions and collateral the five Cs to assess ability and willingness to repay.
questions.explanation: Cover the five Cs of credit appraisal.

questions.text: The policy that covers the policyholders own life is a life insurance policy
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: Life insurance covers the risk of death of the insured life.

questions.text: Explain the procedure for settlement of an insurance claim
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Claim settlement involves notifying the insurer filing documents survey and assessment of loss and payment after verifying the claim is covered.
questions.explanation: Trace the steps from notification to payment.

questions.text: The rate at which the RBI lends to banks against securities is the repo rate
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: The repo rate is the RBIs lending rate to banks.

questions.text: Explain the importance of banks in economic development
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Banks mobilise savings channel funds to productive uses create credit and facilitate trade thereby supporting investment and economic growth.
questions.explanation: Cover savings mobilisation and credit creation.

questions.text: List the risks faced by banks
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Credit risk liquidity risk market risk and operational risk.
questions.explanation: These risks must be managed for bank stability.

questions.text: Explain the role of insurance in risk management
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Insurance is the main method of transferring risk to an insurer which pools risks and compensates losses providing financial certainty.
questions.explanation: Link insurance to risk transfer and pooling.

questions.text: The facility that lets customers withdraw cash using a card is an ATM
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.explanation: ATMs allow cash withdrawal and other services using a card.

questions.text: Explain the types of life insurance policies
questions.subject: Banking and Insurance
questions.correctAnswer: Life policies include whole life endowment term and annuity policies differing in coverage period and whether they combine protection with savings.
questions.explanation: Describe each policy type and its features.
